sealedBefore: the single live run of scripts/phase264-metadata-pilot.mjs
scope: official-domain and document (URL) discovery from metadata only; not independent-test discovery, not evidence, not ranking
inputs: brands of the products of the 19 genuine Phase257 jobs (evaluation/phase257/policy-demo.json); jobs whose product has no brand are reported as unresolved without any request

wikidataMatch.unambiguous: exactly one entity whose label or alias equals the brand (normalised) and whose P31 is a recognised organisation or brand class holds at least one current P856 (not deprecated, no end time P582)
wikidataMatch.ambiguous: more than one such entity: no candidate domain is accepted
wikidataMatch.unresolved: no exact match, no recognised organisation/brand type, or no current P856

candidateDomain.known: host (with or without www.) equals a canonical source host in the private store

resources.accessible: robots.txt permits the sitemap path and at least one sitemap parsed (Phase75)
resources.blocked: robots denies, or the provider answered 401/403/429 or sent Retry-After
resources.unavailable: no parsable sitemap (404, wrong type, parse failure), a 5xx, a network error or the per-host budget ended

urlClasses.exact_identifier: the URL path carries one of the job product's exact identifiers (Phase261 rule)
urlClasses.attribution_unknown: no exact identifier in the URL and no other model code
urlClasses.other_model_rejected: the URL names a different model code
urlClasses.already_observed: normalised URL equals a retained revision URL
urlClasses.duplicate: the same normalised URL again for the same job
urlClasses.category_irrelevant: a lead whose path carries no category term and no exact identifier

success: the run completes within every limit with zero integrity violations, whatever the yield; yield is reported, not tuned
